title: STANDING COMMITTEE ON EDUCATION, WOMEN, CHILDREN, YOUTH AND SPORTS
summary: The Department-related Parliamentary Standing Committee on Education, Women, Children, Youth and Sports headed by Shri Mukul Wasnik, M.P., Rajya Sabha presented the Report on Reforms and Strengthening of the National Testing Agency (NTA) pertaining to the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education to the Hon’ble Chairman, Rajya Sabha on 9th October, 2026.
